work.title: Review variance and stdev implementation
work.result:
APPROVE: commit 42a2da1 implements population variance and stdev correctly.

variance(xs) materializes the iterable, raises ValueError on empty input, and divides the sum of squared deviations by n (not n-1). stdev(xs) is sqrt(variance(xs)), so empty input raises ValueError from variance before the square root. Checked the textbook series [2, 4, 4, 4, 5, 5, 7, 9]: mean 5, sum of squares 32, population variance 4, stdev 2 (sample variance would be 32/7). [-1, 0, 1] is 2/3 and sqrt(2/3). n=1 and a constant series are 0.

Tests pin that population result, fractional values via assertAlmostEqual, zero spread including a single element, one-pass iterators, and ValueError for both functions on [] and iter([]), with subTest. Existing add and mean tests still pass. python3 -m unittest discover -s tests: 7 tests, OK. No implementation edits.
